name: Maki
source:
A woman who was rescued.

Maki is a very quiet young lady. She always feels distant from other people. But since she's been spending a lot of time around Shou lately, she's starting to realize that she's developing feelings for him. When she was saved, she realized that she had lost her memories regarding her past.
